From: Sam Carter <sam@patchworklabs.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick q: GitHub App scopes + demo request

Hi Hannah,

We just signed up and spun up a test connector from our side (thanks for making that flow so fast). Before we book a demo, a couple quick questions from my platform engineer:

- Can Redwood's GitHub App be installed to orgs that restrict third-party OAuth apps (we typically use org-limited installs)?
- How do webhooks behave on delivery failure — are there automatic retries and backoffs?
- Can we test against private repos in a staging tenant without exposing prod data?

Happy to do a 30-min walkthrough — we care mostly about installation flow and webhook reliability. Our team is PST-based; best times are mornings next week.

Would appreciate a short demo and if possible a security pre-call with your security/SE to talk SOC2 evidence and allowed data flows.

Thanks,
Sam Carter
Platform Lead, Patchwork Labs
sam@patchworklabs.com
